title: mov.rms~

messages.description: the RMS over the time window

arguments.description: sets number of samples in the window

methods.description: 'n' number of last samples to apply the average to (the filter is cleared when changed)
sets new maximum size and clears buffer's memory

body: [mov.rms~] gives you a running/moving RMS (Root Mean Square) over a time window of samples. At each sample, the RMS of the last 'n' sample is given.
